# legacy_patterns.txt — fixture tier-5 allow list for the legacy corpora.
# Same format as settings.json permissions.allow entries; one per line.
# `acme-*` are fictional programs so tier 2 never allows them by itself:
# a pass in bash_legacy_allow.txt proves tier 5 did the allowing.
# `true` and `echo` are deliberately NOT listed: in the negative corpus
# they stand in for "some other command the list never approved".
Bash(acme-cli status:*)
Bash(acme-cli logs:*)
Bash(acme-report:*)
Bash(head:*)
Bash(grep:*)
Bash(wc:*)
